library_under_test: wt/funnel-defaults fast-forwarded to main e89f54b9 before the build (includes f097391c: Init::default() = best_of(16), NonfinitePositionPolicy::RejectLeaf default). ALGORITHM_REVISION walnutpie-warmup-telemetry-tau0.6-m1-r2-e1-d3-v10. The house funnel check passes explicit starts, so the Init default does not enter; RejectLeaf is the live nonfinite policy and its rejection counts are recorded.
question: Q1: is the shipped default's funnel tail estimate calibrated: is the distribution of z over 30 fresh seeds consistent with N(0,1), and what is the exceedance rate of |z| > 2?
Q2: does delta = 2 (the WP49 efficiency candidate) stay calibrated, and what does it cost in divergences and depth caps?
Q3: at the house 1,000/1,000 budget, how do default, delta 2 and delta 0.5 compare on the same seeds?
change_under_test: None in the library. Arms differ only in Tuning::max_error (delta); everything else is the shipped sampler default (Tuning::default(), Adaptation::default(), Metric::diagonal(), Limits::admit_worst_case()).
target: Neal's 10-D funnel, omega ~ N(0, 3^2), x_i | omega ~ N(0, exp(omega)); starts omega in {-3,-1,1,3}, x = 0; four chains, four threads.
statistic: P(omega < -5) pooled over the 4 chains, exact 0.0477903522728147; z = (estimate - exact) / MCSE where MCSE = diagnostics::mcse_mean of the indicator (ArviZ-style; the house gate statistic). Also recorded: P(omega < -6) (exact 0.0227501319481792) and its z, batch-means z (40 batches per chain), omega variance (exact 9), rank R-hat / bulk / tail ESS of all 10 coordinates, retained divergences, depth caps, refinement exhaustions, invalid stops, nonfinite-position rejections, total and retained gradients, end-of-warmup step per chain, Posterior::chain_warnings().
seed_check: git grep -lwE '5301(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30)' over every tracked file of main e89f54b9 (artifacts included): no hit; regex over 2,019 protocol.json / PREREGISTRATION.md files in C:/dev/owalnuts-wt/*/STUDIES and C:/dev/owalnuts/STUDIES: no hit.

B.role: companion at the house budget; descriptive except prediction P5. Coordinator scope rule: run B only if block A finishes within 2.5 h of the freeze, otherwise record it as not run.

run_order: Block A: seeds ascending, within a seed arms in order default, delta2. Then block B: seeds ascending, within a seed default, delta2, delta0.5. One process per cell, strictly sequential, four threads. A cell that errors is recorded as an error file and counts as a failure (|z| > 2, not gross-safe); never rerun.
calibration_tests: Over the 30 block-A z values per arm: exceedance count k = #{|z| > 2} with the exact binomial upper tail P(X >= k | n 30, p 0.0455); mean z with the test mean * sqrt(30) ~ N(0,1); sample sd (n-1) with the chi-square variance test (29 df, two-sided); one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov against N(0,1) (asymptotic Kolmogorov p). 'Consistent with N(0,1)' = all three p-values (mean, variance, KS) >= 0.05. The text histogram uses bins of width 1 on [-5, 5] with open end bins.

predictions.P4_definition: block A total retained divergences over 30 cells; delta2 total <= 3 x default total (if default total is 0, held iff delta2 total is 0)
predictions.P5_block_B: block B total retained divergences over 30 seeds: delta0.5 strictly fewest and delta2 strictly most (ties fail)

decision_rules.R1: If default's block-A exceedance rate exceeds 20 % (k > 6 of 30) or |mean z| > 0.5, the headline is a calibration failure of the shipped default, with the direction of bias (sign of mean z, and of the pooled tail-mass error).
decision_rules.R2: Recommend delta = 2 as a default candidate for a posteriordb confirmation iff ALL of: (a) delta2 block-A exceedance count <= default's + 2; (b) |mean z (delta2)| <= 0.5; (c) pooled block-A retained divergence rate of delta2 = total retained divergences / (30 x 4 x 20,000) < 0.001.
decision_rules.no_flip: No default changes in this study under any outcome; output is a safety verdict plus a recommendation.

descriptive: WP37A F3 gross safety per seed (zero retained divergences, rank R-hat(omega) <= 1.05, |P5 - exact| <= 0.025, |P6 - exact| <= 0.015, omega variance in [5, 13]); pooled tail mass across seeds; min bulk ESS per gradient; depth caps; end-of-warmup steps; chain_warnings counts by kind; at 1,000/1,000 also the house health gates (max rank R-hat <= 1.01, min bulk and tail ESS >= 400 over all 10 coordinates, zero retained divergences). Wall times are contended and labelled so.
pre_freeze_runs: Non-evidence, disclosed: (1) default 2,000/20,000 seed 94902 reproduced WP49's cell exactly (z -4.21, 3,233,034 calls) both before and after the merge of main; (2) delta2 2,000/20,000 seed 94902 (z -0.09, pre-merge); (3) delta0.5 and default 1,000/1,000 seed 5 (pipeline checks). Outputs in the session scratchpad, uncommitted. The WP49 12-seed funnel table and WP42's 3-seed d05 row were known before the predictions were written (they are the task's predictions).
